text: Only he who has measured the dominion of force, and knows how not to respect it, is capable of love and justice.
author: Simone Weil
visual_brief: Precise engineering cross-section of a monolithic sea breakwater resisting immense hydrostatic load. White lines on black show orthographic cutaways, foundation bedrock hatching, and crisp force-vector arrows indicating crushing external pressures met by solid structural geometry.
alt: Engineering cross-section diagram of a breakwater resisting heavy force vectors
